name: Wayfare
summary: Warm, filmic small-group tour operator site in sand, near-black and sun yellow, with a wide grotesk, inset rounded photo windows framed by a 12px margin, full-image trip cards and a dark hover list of travel styles.

fonts.pairing: Clash Grotesk 500 with tight negative tracking for display and headings, General Sans for body, labels and tracked uppercase eyebrows

signature: photo windows: full-width rounded panels inset 12px from the viewport edge, used for hero, travel styles, quote and closing CTA
floating pill nav bar centred over the hero photo with a sun-yellow button that carries a round arrow chip
trip cards that are all photo, with duration and difficulty chips top left, title and price low over a dark gradient, yellow pill button bottom right
dark panel list of travel styles: big numbered rows where hovering one lights it up and swaps the photo beside it
imagery: warm film-grain landscape photography with lifted blacks: coastal cliffs, mountain valleys, pagodas, vineyards, deserts, sails at golden hour
layout_grid: 1440px canvas, 70px side padding, 112px section padding, 12px window inset, 3-column trip grid, 24px card radius, full pills for buttons and chips
